description: real OpenAlex works (trimmed) for the DBLP sample works
selection_rule: DBLP works = every record of datasets/samples/dblp/dblp-sample-50.xml (the 50 records of selection-10k with the smallest sha256(seed|key), seed scholarchain-dblp-2026-11-16); for each, the DOI-verified Crossref response and DOI-verified OpenAlex work(s) from the 2026-11-22 retrieval; lines sorted by dblp_key
trim_rule: OpenAlex work fields kept: id, doi, title, publication_year, cited_by_count, ids; authorships[] reduced to author_position, raw_author_name, author{id,display_name,orcid}, institutions[]{id,display_name,ror,country_code}; primary_location reduced to source{id,display_name,issn_l}; everything else dropped (notably abstract_inverted_index and topics).
